beats.title: Intake
beats.body: Everything is ⟦entity⟧ until we say otherwise. It is the one word nobody has asked us to check. Below it the work divides, and the division goes on file under your name.

beats.title: Nothing To Weigh
beats.body: Nothing under ⟦abstraction⟧ can be lifted or weighed, so the machines file here fastest. Every way down is open. None of them is checked.

beats.title: Signed Off Upstream
beats.body: ⟦physical entity⟧ was signed off before you arrived. Everything under it can be weighed, which is why we report on this side and not the other.

beats.title: Held Against Nothing
beats.body: An ⟦attribute⟧ is what a thing is like, held against nothing in particular. Two ways down are open and both are being filled while you stand here.

beats.title: Something Happened
beats.body: ⟦event⟧ means something happened. The record does not say to whom, and the machines are filing under it faster than anyone is reading.

beats.title: Filed Together
beats.body: A ⟦group⟧ is things filed together. Nothing requires them to have anything in common, and below here most of them do not.

beats.title: Against A Scale
beats.body: ⟦measure⟧ is a thing held against a scale someone agreed on. The agreement is not filed here. Only the number is.

beats.title: Inside Only
beats.body: ⟦psychological feature⟧ holds what happens inside and leaves no trace outside. We file it anyway, at the same rate as everything else.

beats.title: Between Two Things
beats.body: A ⟦relation⟧ is not a thing. It is what sits between two of them, and it is filed as though it were a thing.

beats.title: Whoever Filed It
beats.body: ⟦causal agent⟧ is whatever made something happen. The machines file causes at a rate we publish weekly. Nothing on the record says who read it.

beats.title: What It Is Made Of
beats.body: ⟦matter⟧ is what a thing is made of, before anyone asks what it is for. One way down holds together. The others do not.

beats.title: Counted Once
beats.body: ⟦object⟧ is anything you can point at and count once. What sits below was made, and nothing filed says by whom.

beats.title: Still Running
beats.body: A ⟦process⟧ has not finished, so nothing about it can be confirmed yet. It is filed as confirmed.

beats.title: Outline Only
beats.body: ⟦shape⟧ is the outline and nothing inside it. Two ways down, and the graph no longer files them the way you were taught.

beats.title: Someone Did It
beats.body: An ⟦act⟧ is an event with someone behind it. The name of the someone is not a field.

beats.title: People, Filed
beats.body: A ⟦social group⟧ is people, filed. The filing outlives the people and keeps being served.

beats.title: Settled Already
beats.body: A ⟦definite quantity⟧ is settled before anyone looks at it. Below here the settling stops matching what was settled.

beats.title: Measured By Itself
beats.body: A ⟦fundamental quantity⟧ is measured against nothing but itself. Everything under it inherits that, whether or not it earns it.

beats.title: Why It Moved
beats.body: ⟦motivation⟧ is why something moved. It is inferred and then stored as though it were observed.

beats.title: One Against Another
beats.body: A ⟦magnitude relation⟧ holds one size against another. Neither size is filed. Only the holding.

beats.title: Held By Someone
beats.body: ⟦possession⟧ is a thing with a holder attached. The holder is a field. Nothing checks it.

beats.title: Alive Or Filed As Alive
beats.body: ⟦organism⟧ is the line between alive and not. Below it the machines have been filing for longer than anyone here has been reading.

beats.title: Holds Its Shape
beats.body: ⟦solid⟧ holds its shape until something else acts on it. That is the whole definition, and it is the last one down here that fits on a line.

beats.title: Parts, Counted Once
beats.body: A ⟦whole⟧ is parts counted once, on the understanding that nobody recounts. Below here the parts stop agreeing on what they belong to.

beats.title: Observed, Not Explained
beats.body: A ⟦phenomenon⟧ is something observed. Nothing under it is explained, and the record does not distinguish the two.

beats.title: Closed Outline
beats.body: A ⟦figure⟧ is a shape that closed. What is under it was closed by the graph, not by anyone. It continues either way.

beats.title: Kept Doing
beats.body: ⟦activity⟧ is an act that kept going. Nothing checks whether it should have. It continues below.
